object.attr: as implemented: a draft can be printed for review before it is committed; MELLON-PDF-SRS-90 and MELLON-PDF-SRS-103 would make such a PDF say so. Limited to an export that chooses no version, so that exporting an earlier version (MELLON-PDF-SRS-17, MELLON-PDF-SRS-18) doesn't contradict it (review Q6).
object.description: When an export chooses no version, Mellon shall export the document as the working copy holds the document, with the document's uncommitted changes.
